title: UHS Introduces Digital Platform for Medical Training in Punjab
excerpt: The University of Health Sciences has launched PRIME, a new digital platform to integrate medical training monitoring across Punjab.
body_html:
The University of Health Sciences (UHS) has launched a new province-wide digital platform named PRIME. The system is designed to integrate and monitor medical training across Punjab.

By introducing this digital solution, the university aims to streamline the oversight of medical education and training programs throughout the region. Further details regarding the rollout and specific features of the platform were part of the initial announcement.
